SELECT T.* FROM T_CORE_TABLE T
ORDER BY
T.ID

SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT UPPER(COL.TABLE_NAME) TABLENAME, UPPER(COL.COLUMN_NAME) FIELDNAME, COL.UDT_NAME FIELDTYPE, CASE COL.IS_NULLABLE WHEN 'YES' THEN '1' ELSE '0' END ALLOWNULL, CASE COL.UDT_NAME WHEN 'varchar' THEN COL.CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH ELSE NULL END FIELDLENGTH, REPLACE(COALESCE(COL.COLUMN_DEFAULT, ''), '''', '') DEFAULTVALUE, COL.NUMERIC_PRECISION "PRECISION", COL.NUMERIC_SCALE "SCALE", COALESCE(DES.DESCRIPTION, '') FIELDCOMMENT FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS COL LEFT JOIN PG_DESCRIPTION DES ON COL.TABLE_NAME ::REGCLASS = DES.OBJOID AND COL.ORDINAL_POSITION = DES.OBJSUBID WHERE COL.TABLE_SCHEMA = 'public' ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION) T
